metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Cyprien Hallé: agent guardrails and CPTO skills.

plugins.name: agent-guardrails
plugins.description: Gate risky tool calls on whether a human is watching: tiers, scope windows, a hashed audit log, and a PR guard that repairs after creation.

plugins.name: cpto-skills
plugins.description: Thirteen skills for running product and engineering with agents: spec, gate, open-pr, review-pr, fix-review, worktrees, handoff, spoken briefings, critique, headless jobs, writing doctrine.
